passage.text: Do you want a healthier life?
passage.reading: duː juː ˈwɑːnt ə ˈhɛlθiər ˈlaɪf?

passage.text: You don't need to change everything.
passage.reading: juː ˈdoʊnt ˈniːd tə ˈtʃeɪndʒ ˈɛvriθɪŋ.

passage.text: Small habits can bring big benefits.
passage.reading: ˈsmɔːl ˈhæbɪts kən ˈbrɪŋ ˈbɪɡ ˈbɛnəfɪts.

passage.text: Drink a glass of water when you get up, and eat a good breakfast.
passage.reading: ˈdrɪŋk ə ˈɡlæs əv ˈwɔːtər wɛn juː ˈɡɛt ˈʌp, ənd ˈiːt ə ˈɡʊd ˈbrɛkfəst.

passage.text: Take the stairs, and walk for twenty minutes every day.
passage.reading: ˈteɪk ðə ˈstɛrz, ənd ˈwɔːk fər ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

passage.text: Turn off your phone an hour before bedtime, and go to bed at the same time every night.
passage.reading: ˈtɜːrn ˈɔːf jʊr ˈfoʊn ən ˈaʊər bɪˈfɔːr ˈbɛdtaɪm, ənd ˈɡoʊ tə ˈbɛd ət ðə ˈseɪm ˈtaɪm ˈɛvri ˈnaɪt.

passage.text: Every evening, write three good things about your day in a notebook.
passage.reading: ˈɛvri ˈiːvnɪŋ, ˈraɪt ˈθriː ˈɡʊd ˈθɪŋz əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈdeɪ ɪn ə ˈnoʊtbʊk.

passage.text: Call a friend, and say "thank you" more often.
passage.reading: ˈkɔːl ə ˈfrɛnd, ənd ˈseɪ ˈθæŋk juː ˈmɔːr ˈɔːfən.

passage.text: These habits are good for your body and your mental health.
passage.reading: ðiːz ˈhæbɪts ər ˈɡʊd fər jʊr ˈbɑːdi ənd jʊr ˈmɛntəl ˌhɛlθ.

passage.text: Don't try all ten habits in one week.
passage.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈtraɪ ˈɔːl ˈtɛn ˈhæbɪts ɪn ˈwʌn ˈwiːk.

passage.text: This week, try two of them. That's your goal!
passage.reading: ðɪs ˈwiːk, ˈtraɪ ˈtuː əv ðɛm. ðæts jʊr ˈɡoʊl!

passage.text: Be positive, and you'll soon see a big difference!
passage.reading: bi ˈpɑːzətɪv, ənd juːl ˈsuːn ˈsiː ə ˈbɪɡ ˈdɪfrəns!
